title: Tractor Trail A-Z
hook: Chug, turn, stop—then on we roll!
A to Z around the farm we go!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one-beat retrieval gap with percussion drop-out
visualStyle: bright 3D farm-tool storybook, tractor red and crop green accents, simple field backdrop, separated clean subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child riding a slow imaginary tractor circuit and noticing what each stop is for
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: restart the wheel pulse and signal the next leg of the route
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: stop-go 4/4 wheel pulse with two-beat chug pickups
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written route narration; wheel/row/turn/stop words recur lightly while each object receives its own physical or functional image
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: tractor stop cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe gesture -> roll onward
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. fiddle or woodblock answers after the target, with a warm porch pulse
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: fiddle or woodblock answers after the target, with a warm porch pulse
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make the tractor pulse carry the alphabet through an actual working route: start, roll, stop, notice, turn, and come back with the farm changed by the day's work.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child rides an imagined tractor route around barn, pond, rows, orchard, animal yard and porch; wheel words and stop/go syntax provide the signature cadence.
semanticArc: route crosses animals and field edges
work stops reach orchard and animal areas
last row turns home and the engine rests
forbiddenGenericLanguage: tools and crops from A to Z
point and name it on the trail
